next_move.instructions:
The cube has 54 stickers in face order U R F D L B. Each face has 9 stickers, numbered 1 through 9 row-major as viewed directly from outside that face, using the Kociemba convention. The unfolded net has U above F, L F R B across, and D below F. Each sticker letter is the face/colour to which it belongs in the solved cube. Centres stay fixed. The unique solved facelets string is UUUUUUUUURRRRRRRRRFFFFFFFFFDDDDDDDDDLLLLLLLLLBBBBBBBBB. Only the 18 listed face turns are allowed; each costs one move, including a half-turn. Whole-cube rotations are not allowed. Observation fields: facelets, facelet_order, recent_moves (last 6), moves_used, moves_remaining. Select exactly one listed move. The net field shows the same cube state in unfolded form.
Choose the single next move most likely to progress toward the solved cube.
